description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController, providing endpoints for greeting, documentation redirection, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller that handles basic endpoints including greeting, documentation redirection, health check, and info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message when the root URL is accessed.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to Swagger UI, constructing an absolute URL that preserves the original request scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Provides basic application information, including project name.
